quote: The Sunset Retreat experience with Belle and Jaimi was truly wonderful. A nurturing experience, from the warmth I felt from the onset of arriving and right thru. Belle, your considered planning and vision to make us feel special is a credit to you. I left grounded, inspired, cared for and mindful of my body and how treating myself with kindness is the best investment inside and out. Keep shining with your beautiful heart x
reviewer_note: Kept for records only. The site shows the descriptor, never the name, until Belle has permission.
